crossRefs.note: “Can a virgin forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? Yet my people have forgotten me for days without number.
Yahweh said to me, “Backsliding Israel has shown herself more righteous than treacherous Judah.
But they didn’t listen or turn their ear, but walked in their own counsels and in the stubbornness of their evil heart…
For Israel has behaved extremely stubbornly, like a stubborn heifer. Then how will Yahweh feed them like a lamb in a…
My people are determined to turn from me. Though they call to the Most High, he certainly won’t exalt them.
Your habitation is in the middle of deceit. Through deceit, they refuse to know me,” says Yahweh.
Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.
who tell the seers, “Don’t see!” and the prophets, “Don’t prophesy to us right things. Tell us pleasant things.…
He feeds on ashes. A deceived heart has turned him aside; and he can’t deliver his soul, nor say, “Isn’t there a lie in…
Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.
even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
Nevertheless, hold that which you have firmly until I come.
O Yahweh, don’t your eyes look on truth? You have stricken them, but they were not grieved. You have consumed them, but…
but if you refuse and rebel, you will be devoured with the sword; for the mouth of Yahweh has spoken it.”
But they refused to listen, and turned their backs, and stopped their ears, that they might not hear.
Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.
See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how…

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Why then have the people of Jerusalem fallen back by a perpetual backsliding? They cling to deceit. They refuse to return.
translations.bsb: Why then have these people turned away? Why does Jerusalem always turn away? They cling to deceit; they refuse to return.
translations.kjv: Why then is this people of Jerusalem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding? they hold fast deceit, they refuse to return.
translations.asv: Why then is this people of Jerusalem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding? they hold fast deceit, they refuse to return.
